data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for offline speech recognition using Vosk toolkit.
data.what_it_does: Provides offline speech-to-text functionality using the Vosk toolkit across multiple platforms. Supports loading models, creating recognizers, processing audio data, and handling microphone input.
use_when: You need speech recognition that works completely offline.
You want on-device processing for privacy or connectivity reasons.
avoid_when: You require cloud-based large vocabulary speech recognition engines.
You are targeting Web platforms where the plugin has limited native binary support.
strengths: Works completely offline without sending audio data to external servers.
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, macOS, Windows, and Linux.
weaknesses: Requires manual installation of native binaries on desktop and iOS platforms.
Web platform support is limited or stub-based.
data.setup_notes: Requires downloading native binaries via CLI for iOS, macOS, Linux, and Windows, plus configuring ProGuard and microphone permissions on Android.
